about: Jupiter Wagons Limited manufactures and sells railway wagons, wagon components, and railway transportation equipment in India and internationally. It offers open, covered, flat, hopper, container, and special purpose wagons; and wagon accessories, such as alloy steel cast bogies, high tensile center buffer couplers, and high-capacity draft gears.
